data.title: Clone Services + sibling DNS rewrite|For each Service selecting a stamped workload: clone Service with same name suffix + mutated selector -> cluster DNS <svc>-wt-<name> reaches only worktree pods. Env/arg rewrite in clone entities: sibling refs resolve to clone names for worktree-flagged resources, stay bare for shared. No mesh required. Tests: selector uniqueness, env rewrite.
